name: Memory Village
intro: Welcome to Memory Village. I feel it hum.
Every box here can hold one thing.
This village runs on keys and values.

1: The boxes wait for a name.
A faint glow comes from the vault.
2: A label holds a memory in place.
Storing a value needs a key.
A name and a thing. That is the trick.
What you set, you can get back.

ok: A crystal forms. It feels solid.
Stored. I can see it now.
okFirst: Your first store. That is the heart of it.
A box, a label, a value. You did it.
Welcome to the art of SET.
error: The vault did not take that.
That key is not here yet.
A misfire, but the village forgives.
expired: Your crystal faded — it had a timer!
The torch went dark. Time won.
A key just expired into the void.

curiosity: I wonder what you will name next.
Each key is a small story.
humor: That key has more lives than a cat.
I count keys while I wait. Exciting, I know.
Even memory needs a nap now and then.
wisdom: A clear name is half the craft.
Name keys like you will read them later.
sternness: A label means nothing without a value.
Stop guessing. Type the shape I showed you.
The vault will not open to a blank key.
